description: Trafiksäkerhetsklass Passage, GCM is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis.trafikverket.se. A GCM passage is an orderly passage for pedestrians and/or cyclists/mopedists crossing a road. The junction itself can be level-separated or in planes. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic safety class Passage, GCM" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include NVDB - STVDB. The listing shows 2026-08-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
